name: Brayne Testimonials
description: Collect customer reviews through a moderated form and display them as testimonial blocks: grid, slider, or feature quote, with optional star ratings, avatars, and an honest activity strip.
author: Brayne Smart solutions Corp

notifyEmail.label: Notification email
notifyEmail.description: Where new submissions are announced. Empty sends no email.

requireCaptcha.label: Require CAPTCHA
requireCaptcha.description: Uses the site's own configured CAPTCHA provider (Turnstile, hCaptcha, or reCAPTCHA). With no provider configured, submissions rely on moderation.

minRatingToDisplay.label: Minimum star rating
minRatingToDisplay.description: 0 shows everything. When a minimum is set, unrated reviews are hidden from the site but stay visible in the inbox.

collectionUrl.label: Reviews page address
collectionUrl.description: The page that holds the Review form block, so the admin can copy a shareable link.
